title: ‘Line their own coffers’: independent MPs lambast Labor’s last-minute changes to election funding laws
summary_full: Crossbenchers say the proposals could allow an ‘uncapped amount of money’ to flow to major parties through investment fundsGet our daily political email, free app or daily news podcastIndependent MPs say the government’s last-minute changes to controversial election funding laws would allow “an uncapped amount of money” to flow to the major parties through investment funds.The amendments to the incoming federal electoral laws, which the government describes as “technical”, were introduced on Tuesday afternoon and come weeks before they are set to begin operating.Sign up for Guardian Australia’s Politics, really newsletter here Continue reading...
